Current Learners
Discover a wealth of resources tailored to your academic journey at the Florida A&M
University College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute of Public Health
(CoPPS, IPH). Here, we provide a comprehensive support system for your coursework,
offering practical experiences and opportunities for public service integral to your
academic program. This hub serves as a central point for your career development,
extending support before, during, and after your graduation from our esteemed program.
Navigate your educational path with ease as you explore the vast resources designed
to enhance your learning experience. Gain valuable insights through practical experiences
and contribute meaningfully to public service initiatives, both crucial components
of our academic programs. Beyond academics, this hub is dedicated to fostering your
career development, ensuring you are well-prepared for success in the dynamic fields
of pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, and public health.
Connect seamlessly with administrators, faculty, staff, fellow students, and accomplished
alumni of the College of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Institute of Public
Health. Stay informed about upcoming events, updates, and valuable insights that contribute
to the vibrant community within our institution. This platform is not just a resource
center; it's a community hub where connections are forged, knowledge is shared, and
success is cultivated. Embrace the opportunities that await you here, and embark on
a fulfilling journey toward a rewarding career in pharmacy and public health.
The FAMU BS in Pharmaceutical Sciences Program: Thriving and Impactful
A Repast and Welcome for BSPS Learners. Photos Courtesy of Johnnie Lee Early.
The B.S. in Pharmaceutical Sciences (BSPS) degree program at Florida A&M University
is thriving—thanks to the outstanding leadership of Director Dr. Tiffany Ardley and
the dedication of our faculty and staff.
Program Outcomes to Date
31 graduates (and growing!)
7 pursuing Ph.D.s — including 6 at FAMU in Pharmaceutical Sciences and 1 at the University
of Florida
2 pursuing Master’s degrees — including 1 at FAMU in Pharmaceutical Sciences
1 MBA graduate
1 Physician Assistant (PA) student at Howard University
1 Medical student at Howard University
2 in pharmaceutical sales
2 in Big Pharma in Regulatory Affairs and Operations
These outcomes underscore the program’s dual strengths: preparing learners for advanced
graduate and professional study, while also launching them directly into impactful
careers.
The success of our BSPS graduates reflects not only their talent and perseverance,
but also the vision, mentoring, and guidance of the FAMU faculty. Their contributions
are advancing pharmaceutical sciences, clinical practice, and the health professions
pipeline nationwide.
